text: Businesswoman/Council Member

I need your vote, please, for important consistency – incumbent not running. For years, I have been consistently working hard for you for transparency and on City issues. Every decision is always in the absolute best interest of our residents, businesses and visitors -- no developer ties. I make no campaign promises, am one of 5. When elected, I spent less than $999 and no campaign signs. I’m not about big money.

I will continue to say “no” to housing development projects and more that do not make sense. I attend/participate in Strategic Planning, Planning Commission, and Orange County Mosquito and Vector Control District Board Meetings (our City Trustee).
I happily volunteer hours daily on social media, in person, phone/email; at community events, and am a proud longtime resident and member of several community organizations.
Please have faith in me – call 714-335-2280 anytime – always accessible to speak with and ask questions.

Your vote ensures my unwavering commitment to you. You will continue to have my time and energy working hard, fully committed to ensuring Fountain Valley remains a nice, very desirable place to live and visit and prosperous for our businesses.
It is my pleasure to serve and represent you.

text: Fountain Valley Mayor/Businessman

I’ve proudly made Fountain Valley my home for 33 years. My wife and our 5 children were all born and raised here. I’m dedicated to making Fountain Valley an even better place to live, so my children can eventually raise their own children here.
I’ve worked in private business for 40 years. With my experience in both the public and private sectors, I know how to run government more like a business.

As your Fountain Valley Mayor and Councilmember, I’ve delivered results since you first elected me four years ago:
Hired new Fire and Police Chiefs
New Public Safety Community Risk Assessment and Standards of
Cover
First-ever Fountain Valley Parks Master Plan
New 16-acre expansion at Fountain Valley Sports Park
Balanced budgets, including paying down pension debt
I lead “Mile with the Mayor” walks to ensure City staff and I are accessible to residents while also encouraging everyone to be active and enjoy Fountain Valley’s outdoors.

If you re-elect me, I’ll continue fighting for you:
Ensure our firefighters and police have what they need to keep
Fountain Valley safe
Enhance Fountain Valley parks and streets
Maintain complete accountability of our taxpayer dollars
Attract and retain good-paying jobs with healthy businesses
I respectfully ask for your vote.
www.Cunneen4FVCityCouncil.com

text: Orange County Commissioner/Businessowner

For over 30 years, Fountain Valley has been my home. My wife, Carrie, and I raised our four children here. I got my start coaching kids in Fountain Valley Pony Baseball, and spent decades coaching young athletes and building local businesses. My business gives young athletes a platform to earn college scholarships while bringing jobs and economic growth to Fountain Valley.
I'm running for City Council because I want to keep Fountain Valley the safe, family-friendly city we all love.
I will support our police and firefighters, ensuring they have the resources to keep our neighborhoods and schools safe, while investing in neighborhood watch and youth outreach programs.

I will champion our small businesses by cutting red tape and streamlining city permits, and work to revitalize our commercial corridors so Fountain Valley remains a place where families and businesses can thrive.

I will fight to preserve the quality of life that makes Fountain Valley special, including stronger oversight of sober living homes to protect our neighborhoods and ensure responsible development that fits our community.
As a business owner, coach, and lifelong community volunteer, I've spent my life building things that last. I'll bring that same commitment to City Hall.
I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: Engineer/Environmentalist

Although I was born in Kansas, I was raised in Fountain Valley, attending Ethan Allen Elementary School in the 1980s and 1990s. I know what living in Fountain Valley is all about. People here want to live in a safe, crime-free community where families can raise kids.

After obtaining my undergraduate degree in electrical engineering and my graduate degree in chemical engineering, I worked to prevent harmful emissions that can cause serious health effects. I believe people should be able to live without the fear of the environment harming them or their loved ones.

I also believe community safety is a fundamental right. Key to safety is having a strong community working harmoniously together to prevent crimes. As a city council member, I will work to foster a stronger community by harnessing and embracing Fountain Valley’s diversity, while refraining from divisive politics.
I respectfully ask for your support and vow to listen to everyone. Together, we will make Fountain Valley better.
/s/ John Nguyen

text: Speaker/Artist/Writer

Ask me anything. My email is publiccomment2025@gmail.com My website is katywrightgallery.com My phone is 714.714.2447. My YouTube channel is www.youtube.com/@katywrightgallery6523 You can watch my many visits to the FVCC lectern.

I believe I can make a difference. I do not vote based on glossy postcards bombarding my mailbox. Too expensive. spending other people’s money to get elected. How do we expect them to approach spending from the dais?
I’m re-using my old campaign signs from last time, only for people who want to display them in their own yards. Contact me if you want one of my old signs.
No council member has more power than 1 vote out of 5. I can’t promise anything except to do my best for us all.

My background: I’m a wife, mother, and grassroots patriot. I retired after 21 years as Communication Technician for ATT. I surveilled network traffic for California and Nevada. Other jobs: CHP Public Safety Dispatcher, commercial driver (school bus, paratransit bus, OCTA route transit bus, taxicab); hotel reservationist, artist, writer, and public speaker. I was a keynote speaker at Toastmasters 2026 District 100 Spring Conference in Pasadena.

text: Community Services Executive

My family is proud to call Fountain Valley home. My husband and I chose to raise our two sons here because it is a safe community with great schools, beautiful parks, and neighbors who genuinely care about one another. I'm running for City Council because I want to help preserve what makes Fountain Valley such a special place to live.

For more than 20 years, I've worked in public service, helping people find solutions during some of the most difficult times in their lives. Today, as Executive Director of a countywide nonprofit, I manage multimillion-dollar budgets, work with local governments and community organizations, and lead teams that serve thousands of Orange County residents every year.

I'll bring that same practical experience to City Hall. My priorities are keeping our neighborhoods safe, supporting our police and firefighters, maintaining our parks and streets, being fiscally responsible with taxpayer dollars, and ensuring City Hall is transparent and responsive.

I'm honored to have earned the endorsement of the Fountain Valley Police Officers Association. Most importantly, I will listen to residents, make thoughtful decisions, and always put Fountain Valley first.
I respectfully ask for your vote.
